_comment: The recall-ranking evaluation set. Two kinds of entry, deliberately mixed:
the four queries the 2026-08-16 ranking diagnosis used (source: diagnosis),
and queries taken verbatim from real production brain_recall_events across
seven different projects (source: session). The real ones matter because a
hand-written query set is a query set somebody unconsciously wrote to pass.
'project' is the repo the session was in — the ground truth for scoring. A
returned row filed under a DIFFERENT project is contamination. Rows that are
unfiled (project_id IS NULL) are neither: nothing claims they belong
elsewhere, and they are what the two-tier filter deliberately admits.
'expect_empty' marks the control: a query about a subject this corpus
contains nothing on. It is REPORTED, not enforced. Measured, its best match
scores 0.78 while real queries score 0.78-0.87 — the distributions overlap,
so no absolute relevance floor can empty it without also emptying real
recalls. Watch the number: the day it separates is the day an absolute floor
becomes settable, and that day arrives by fixing the corpus (99.5% of it is
auto-mined session exhaust), not by tuning the ranking.
